To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a text mining system to help curators in identifying biomedical research articles relevant for protein phosphorylation and that we have made it available as a Web site.
RLIMS P is a Web-based text mining tool to retrieve information on protein phosphorylation and that it was developed as part of the user interactive task of the BioCreativeIV challenge.
RLIMS P is a literature-based extraction system to identify biomedical research articles related to protein phosphorylation, and to extract phosphorylation information from these articles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of text mining tools to support curation and the annotation of protein phosphorylation.

developing a text mining system that is able to automatically identify and extract protein phosphorylation information from the biomedical literature and make it available to researchers and curators.
the development of an efficient and effective text mining tool for protein phosphorylation information retrieval and curation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tool is very useful and can be used for the extraction of protein phosphorylations from the literature.
the system has been developed for the identification of relevant literature on protein phosphorylation and for extracting phosphorylation information from the literature.
RLIMS P has been successfully developed and implemented to facilitate literature based extraction of phosphorylation information.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a text mining tool to extract protein phosphorylation information from the literature.
the RLIMS P system is a useful tool for the identification and retrieval of relevant phosphorylated protein information from the literature.

RLIMS P is a valuable text mining tool for the extraction of protein phosphorylations and the literature based identification of relevant articles for the curation of protein phosphorylation databases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a text mining system can be developed for the identification of literature relevant to a specific domain.
text mining tools are useful in the curation process and can be used by curators to improve their productivity.
text mining tools such as RLIMS P can be used to assist curators in the extraction of relevant information from the biomedical literature and in the annotation of biological databases.
